name: Support Agent Tools
description: Action routing, profile lookup, credits search, ticket creation, profile status, subscription status, and self-service credit-removal tools for the support agent.

creditVerificationEnabled.description: Phase-1 dark-ship flag for credit_verification_check. Accepts true / "true" / "1" / 1; anything else (including absent) keeps the tool disabled. Deliberately untyped: the runtime parse in index.ts is the fail-closed layer, so an unexpected value shape degrades to flag-off instead of failing config validation and breaking plugin load.

profilesClaimSelfEnabled.description: Phase-1 dark-ship flag for profiles_claim_self (gated WRITE: verify the customer's own pending profile claim via muso-cli). Accepts true / "true" / "1" / 1; anything else (including absent) keeps the tool disabled and returning a no-op sentinel. Same fail-closed runtime parse as creditVerificationEnabled.

creditsVerifyEnabled.description: Phase-1 dark-ship flag for credits_verify (gated WRITE: verify/approve the customer's own pending credit request via muso-cli). Accepts true / "true" / "1" / 1; anything else (including absent) keeps the tool disabled and returning a no-op sentinel. Same fail-closed runtime parse as creditVerificationEnabled.

profilesConsolidateEnabled.description: Phase-1 dark-ship flag for profiles_consolidate (gated APPROVAL-tier WRITE: merge the customer's own duplicates into their profile via muso-cli, identity-corroborated server-side). Accepts true / "true" / "1" / 1; anything else (including absent) keeps the tool disabled and returning a no-op sentinel. Same fail-closed runtime parse as creditVerificationEnabled.

foundingBuybackEnabled.description: Dark-ship flag for founding_buyback_link (mints the founding buy-back Stripe Checkout link via muso-cli; founding_status stays ungated read-only). Accepts true / "true" / "1" / 1; anything else (including absent) keeps the mint disabled and returning a no-op sentinel. Same fail-closed runtime parse as creditVerificationEnabled.

retentionOfferEnabled.description: Dark-ship flag for retention_offer_apply (gated WRITE: apply the product's own cancel-flow retention discount to the customer's OWN subscription via muso-cli; retention_offer_check stays ungated read-only). Accepts true / "true" / "1" / 1; anything else (including absent) keeps the apply disabled and returning a no-op sentinel. Same fail-closed runtime parse as creditVerificationEnabled.

cancelSubscriptionEnabled.description: Dark-ship flag for cancel_subscription (gated dangerous-tier WRITE: period-end cancel of the customer's OWN subscription via muso-cli; no money moves — refunds stay on the Operations path). Accepts true / "true" / "1" / 1; anything else (including absent) keeps the cancel disabled and returning a no-op sentinel. Same fail-closed runtime parse as creditVerificationEnabled.

companyFinderRunnerPath.description: Optional absolute override for the atomic company-finder stage runner.

companyFinderDiagnosticsDir.description: Durable directory for exact company-finder stage stdin/stdout/stderr/exit metadata.

orderDetailsRequireIv.description: order_lookup detail gate. Default (absent) and any value except false / "false" / 0 / "0" = ON: order_lookup returns {status, hold} only to every caller, because Intercom Identity Verification is off and a contact's email/external_id is browser-assertable. Set false ONLY after intercom-identity-fix-i2 ships and IV is enforced; then the full order goes to the order's own verified contact (owner anchor). Env fallback ORDER_DETAILS_REQUIRE_IV.

carolineActionsEnabled.description: Dark-ship flag for Caroline's real, safe actions (credit_status_lookup, document_intake, merge_request_intake, credit_trust_handoff; caroline-operator-c1). Accepts true / "true" / "1" / 1; anything else (including absent) keeps all four disabled and returning a no-op sentinel. They never approve, reject, delete, hide or send; approved lines additionally need node-8's /etc/hydra/caroline-actions-lines.enabled. Same fail-closed runtime parse as creditVerificationEnabled.
